## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      3 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jul 29, 2026 - Aug 4, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _SavannahSunshine16_, Aug 4, 2026, 2/5: "So… why I gave it two stars is because of some things I noticed. I’m not criticizing the app or saying it sucks. Not at all! But these things need to be addressed and fixed if possible. The ads: I know you’re getting sick of people telling you to stop the ads. But as someone who can’t pay to stop the ads, it gets annoying that I have to stop chatting with my favorite character to watch 1-5 ads to continue. Please please fix this. Sensitive: Now… I know that this has been fixed a bit but I keep getting censored for no reason when making the AI characters (and there’s no reason for them to be censored or disapproved of). So… please fix this… The coins: Again… the ads to watch to get the coins is fine. BUT I don’t want to download apps that will take up a bunch of storage on my phone to just do something with the AI bot. Originally you could get the coins daily. Now with all these events… you can’t do that anymore because you can’t see it anymore. With all that in mind, again I’m not criticizing the app or you… but I believe I speak for a bunch of us that have these issues… the app is amazing but please take these issues into consideration for fixing. Thank you so much for taking your time to read this!"
            2. _suggestions l guess?_, Aug 4, 2026, 3/5: "seeing the new reels button right there is a bit annoying, if so could we have a button to hide the reels button so are chats can look normal without it? it bugs me a lot and l hate how l cant hide it or move it somewhere to where l cant see it."
            3. _Helena_nvs18_, Jul 29, 2026, 3/5: "Very good application but there are too many ads and bugs. In addition, censorship is much too strict, even in private bots can be blocked even though there is NOTHING that goes against the rules!"
